## About
North Texas Injury & Wellness is a chiropractic orthopedic clinic on Southwest Blvd in Benbrook, serving Benbrook, Fort Worth and the surrounding communities. We focus on more than temporary symptom relief. Our goal is to help your body heal, move, and perform at its best.
Dr. Timothy Odom is a proud native Texan, born in Fort Worth and raised in Aledo. He is a graduate of Parker College of Chiropractic in Dallas, a Diplomate of the American Board of Chiropractic Orthopedists, and one of only a handful of chiropractors in north Texas to be board-certified in chiropractic orthopedics. Along with Dr. Mark Bussell, he established NTIW.
Away from the office, Dr. Odom enjoys time with his wife, Mariya, and their rescue dogs, Bruce and Stefy. Patients have rated the clinic 4.9 from 152 Google reviews.

## Services
- Orthopedic Chiropractic: Care that looks at the spine, nerves, muscles, joints, and extremities together, personalized to improve movement and address the source of your symptoms.
- Spinal Adjustment: Used to address restricted joint movement and improve spinal function, performed according to your condition, exam findings, and treatment plan.
- Auto Accident Recovery: We identify the areas affected by a collision and build a personalized plan to support mobility and recovery.
- Whiplash Treatment: Focused on the areas affected by the injury, and may include chiropractic care and complementary therapies as part of an individualized recovery plan.
- Spinal Decompression: One of the therapies Dr. Odom may use for herniated discs and sciatica, based on your evaluation.
- Herniated Disc: Care for back or neck discomfort and symptoms that travel into the arms or legs, with therapies chosen for your needs.
- Sciatica Treatment: Options selected based on the cause and severity of your symptoms, which may include chiropractic care, decompression, and rehabilitation techniques.
- Cryo-Therapy: A complementary treatment for soreness and discomfort. Our team can help you decide whether it fits your condition and recovery goals.

## FAQ
Q: What happens on my first visit?
A: Expect a thorough exam. Two patients mentioned that Dr. Odom took X-rays and assessed them before treatment began.

Q: I've never been to a chiropractor. Is that okay?
A: Yes. One reviewer on their first-ever appointment said Dr. Odom and his staff put them at ease, explained each step, and answered all of their questions in detail.
